user.title: solarbox.uk devices
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to a solardongleweb server. Enter the server URL and the device ID of the dongle (e.g. {device_id}). All inverter, BMS and status entities will be created automatically.

error.invalid_device_id: Invalid device ID. Use the dg-xxxxxx format (e.g. dg-abc123).
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the server. Check the URL and that the server is reachable.

abort.already_configured: This device ID is already configured.

init.title: solarbox.uk options
init.description: Edit connection options. A fast-data interval of 5 s keeps the dongle in fast mode so data is refreshed every 5 seconds; higher values reduce load on the dongle.
